description: SEC Form 3/4/5 filing index: one row per filing (accession_number) with company, ticker, document_type ('3' initial, '4' change, '5' annual; '4/A' etc. amendments), all reporting_owners and row counts. Source: SEC's quarterly bulk data, 2006 on; newer filings come from the daily feed (source 'sec_edgar_live': Forms 4 and 5 only, envelope fields null, is_amendment unknown). A ticker search also covers symbols the issuer no longer lists. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_insider_filings
